B_product_readiness.name: Workflow B — Product Readiness
B_product_readiness.trigger: New product submitted or briefing uploaded
steps: Check KV / packshot / mockup / video base availability
Check claim and copy approval status
Confirm screen format and duration from screen_formats.json

C_script_creation.name: Workflow C — Script Creation
C_script_creation.trigger: User submits product for scripting (Gate 2 passed)
steps: Receive user input: product name, placement, creative direction
Create scene breakdown with JSON format (per Stage 3 Agent 5 spec)
Flag any missing approvals or blocked elements
STOP — wait for user approval before proceeding

D_keyframe_creation.name: Workflow D — Keyframe Creation
steps: Create initial frame description (includes: product, setting, lighting, camera, safe area)
Create final frame description (includes: product state, claims, badges, lighting resolve)
Create transition bridge frame if needed (middle state)
Check: lighting continuity between initial and final
Check: brand and packshot requirements vs approved source materials
STOP — export prompts and wait for user approval

E_json_prompt_generation.name: Workflow E — JSON Prompt Generation
steps: Convert approved scene descriptions to JSON format (per Stage 3 Agent 8 spec)
Attach initial and final frame file references
Note: if first+last frame required → use veo3-1-first-last-frame-to-video (NOT veo-3.0-generate-001)
Define technical export settings from screen_formats.json
Also save to public/output/ for script consumption
STOP — wait for user approval of JSON

F_video_generation.name: Workflow F — Video Generation
steps: Confirm frame files exist at referenced paths
Dispatch generation: POST /api/veo/generate with approved JSON payload
When done === true: collect video bytes or download URL
Do NOT overwrite previous generations — use timestamp suffix

G_qa_and_delivery.name: Workflow G — QA and Delivery
steps: Technical QA: verify resolution, duration, fps, codec, format
Creative QA: verify motion quality, scene continuity, transition quality
Brand QA: verify packshot accuracy, logo accuracy, brand palette
Claim QA: verify claim placement, badge accuracy, no hallucinated text
Safe area QA: verify 10% margins on all edges
If QA FAIL: document failures, return to Gate 6 or Gate 7
Post-production: upscale to 1792x1536 via Topaz Video Upscaler
Update Master Tracker (Tracker Sync Agent — preserve formula columns)
